'''March 2000 Bochum tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bochum, Germany on 18 March 2000. [[Martin Falke]] won it. It is known from Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d370">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-21-18-03-2000-bochum-germanyd370/ 18-03-2000-bochum-germany], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 21 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-21-18-03-2000-bochum-germanyd370/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Falke]]
